Verses.1:
In that day, this song shall be sung in the land of Judah:
We have a strong city.
	He makes salvation its walls and ramparts.
Verses.2:
Open the gates so that the righteous nation may enter,
	the one that keeps faithful.
Verses.3:
You will keep in perfect peace
	those whose minds are steadfast
	because they trust in You.
Verses.4:
Trust in the LORD forever,
	for in the LORD GOD we have an everlasting rock!

Changes: 2024-05-26 - Paul Prins: Initial translation of verses 1-4.
